title: Anchor a hinged panel and verify its opening direction
applicability: Use for hinged lids, panels or hatches when the same pivot must stay engaged through a defined opening range. Use complementary hinge leaves with a defined axis.
steps: Mount the fixed leaf to a solid landing. Keep brackets and spare studs away from the finger region, especially for a lid that passes close to the support.

Connect hinge_7_in on 4276b to hinge_7_on on 4275b. In the sample the mounting is clocked 180° to make a flat rest pose. Attach the panel to the moving leaf only, or a second rigid contact can lock the assembly.

Declare a revolute range relative to the rest pose. Inspect the sign of the opening angle and sample the full range with the frame in place. Use the pair and position in a collision result to decide where to offset the hinge or cut back the panel.
expected: The leaf opens 60° from flat, stays attached and supported, and clears the anchored leaf at seven samples.

sources.author: Carlos Antelo
sources.title: Openable cabin roof study
sources.adaptation: Reference only. The cabin roof study suggested demonstrating the fixed side separately from the moving cover. The BrickWright guidance and example are original.
